subject: general
question: The 19th Commonwealth Games were organised by________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The **19th Commonwealth Games**, officially known as the XIX Commonwealth Games was held in **New Delhi, India, from 3 to 14 October 2010.**
 
• A total of 4352 athletes from 71 Commonwealth nations and dependencies competed in 21 sports and 272 events, making it the largest Commonwealth Games to date. 
 
• This was the first time India has hosted the Games and only the second time the event has been held in Asia after Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia in 1998.
 
• The official mascot was Shera, an anthropomorphised tiger.
 
• The final medal tally was led by Australia with 74 golds and 177 medals overall.
 
• India achieved its best performance ever at the Commonwealth Games, finishing second overall by winning 38 golds, 27 silver and 36 bronze total of 101 medals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **2022 Commonwealth Games** held in Birmingham, England.
 
• The final medal tally was led by Australia, with 67 Gold and a total of 178 medals. Whereas, India stands fourth in the rank with 22 Gold and total 61 medals.
 
• The 2026 Commonwealth Games will be held in Australia for the sixth time.
 
• The three nations to have hosted the Commonwealth Games most time are Australia (5), Canada (4), and New Zealand (3).
